subject: HIPAA BAA eligibility - follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Dr. Susan Lee <susan.lee@medstreamhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: HIPAA BAA eligibility - follow-up

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock your security and procurement teams:

Key points from our call:
- MedStream plans to send Redwood PHI in scoped use cases (clinical notes + patient identifiers) for feature X.
- Primary question: can Redwood execute a BAA and what deployment options meet your PHI requirements?
- InfoSec indicated they will run a vendor security questionnaire (they said they would email the form).

What I can confirm up-front:
- Redwood currently has SOC 2 Type II reports available for customers; I attached a short SOC 2 summary for your InfoSec to review.
- For PHI workloads we recommend Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) which gives customer-managed networking and KMS integrations.
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) offers data isolation and may be eligible for PHI with contractual controls; we can provide the deployment checklist and isolation details.
- Our hosted public API is generally not used for PHI unless paired with specific contractual and architectural controls — we should treat that as a less-preferred path for now.

Requested items / next steps:
1) Susan / MedStream InfoSec: please share the vendor security questionnaire when available (or you can attach it here).
2) I will loop in our legal and compliance teams and share a BAA template and SOC 2 summary.
3) Rishi and I can schedule a technical deep-dive to walk through deployment options and the PHI handling flow (KV cache, data retention, keys).

I attached the SOC 2 summary to start. Let me know if you want us to send a formal BAA template now or wait until after InfoSec completes the questionnaire.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

From: Dr. Susan Lee <susan.lee@medstreamhealth.com>

Subject: Re: HIPAA BAA eligibility - follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Yes, clinical notes with identifiers are in scope for the pilot.

I attached our vendor security questionnaire (InfoSec prefers a completed PDF). Can you confirm:
- Does Redwood sign a standard BAA?
- Does Redwood retain any PHI by default, or is data only transient during inference?
- Which deployment mode (Private VPC / Dedicated / Hosted) would you recommend for production PHI handling?

I looped in our InfoSec team (infosec@medstreamhealth.com) to own questionnaire intake and technical validation.

Thanks,
Susan
Dr. Susan Lee
VP Clinical Programs
MedStream Health
Attachment: MedStream_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Dr. Susan Lee <susan.lee@medstreamhealth.com>, MedStream InfoSec <infosec@medstreamhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA BAA eligibility - follow-up

Susan / InfoSec team —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire; received and attaching a BAA template for your review. Quick answers to the items you flagged:

1) BAA: Redwood is able to sign a Business Associate Agreement. We typically provide our BAA template for review and execution; legal can accept reasonable redlines. (Attached: Redwood_BAA_Template.docx)

2) PHI retention: by default Redwood does not use customer data to train models. For hosted API usage, request/response data can be logged for operational reasons unless explicitly disabled by contract; for PHI we recommend contractual language and deployment configs that disable logging and enable strict retention.

3) Recommended deployment modes for PHI:
   - Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem): recommended for PHI. Provides customer-managed networking, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit logging under customer control.
   - Redwood Dedicated: may be suitable for PHI with contractual commitments around data isolation and retention (we can provide the Dedicated isolation checklist).
   - Hosted public API: not recommended for PHI unless you require a fast POC and accept contractual constraints — we should treat this as a fallback and engage Legal.

Next steps (proposed):
- Our legal (cc'd Monica) will send the BAA template and is available to review redlines.
- Rishi / our infra team can run a short technical deep-dive with your InfoSec to go through deployment and key management (we can do this next week).
- We will complete your questionnaire and return the PDF within 2 business days after the deep-dive / Q&A.

Please confirm availability for a 30–45 minute technical call next week and whether InfoSec prefers answers inline in the PDF or a redline + Q&A approach.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Attachments: Redwood_BAA_Template.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Dr. Susan Lee <susan.lee@medstreamhealth.com>, MedStream InfoSec <infosec@medstreamhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA BAA eligibility - follow-up

Hi Susan / InfoSec —

Happy to engage on the BAA. A few notes from Legal:
- Redwood executes standard BAAs and we can usually accommodate routine redlines related to data retention and access.
- For PHI we will include contractual controls around logging, retention windows, and KMS usage.
- If you plan to use Dedicated instead of Private, please flag specific isolation or audit requirements now so we can validate operational feasibility.

Proposed timeline: once InfoSec confirms the questionnaire items that need follow-up, we can provide completed answers + a BAA redline response within ~2 business days. If you need a faster turnaround, please call that out and we will prioritize.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
